title: Undefined crash in global error handler
description: The global error handler middleware crashes with 'Cannot read properties of undefined' when an upstream error object lacks a details field, which happens for a subset of validation errors, turning a handled 4xx response into an unhandled 500.
acceptanceCriteria: The error handler never throws regardless of which optional fields are present on the incoming error object.
Errors without a details field still produce a well-formed response body with a sensible default.
Errors with a details field continue to include it unchanged in the response.
A regression test covering an error object missing each optional field individually passes.
verificationMethod: test-suite: run the error-handler unit tests, including the new missing-field regression cases.
groundTruth: The handler accesses error.details.code without checking that details is defined; the fix adds a guard (optional chaining plus a default) before accessing nested fields.
